tinker.name: SVG Editor
tinker.description: Draw and edit SVG vector graphics, with PNG export

zh-CN.name: SVG 编辑
zh-CN.description: 绘制与编辑 SVG 矢量图，支持导出 PNG

open.description: Open an SVG file in the editor. Same as opening a file in the UI. Call this before editing an existing file.

path.description: Absolute path to an SVG file

get.description: Get the current SVG content, file path, canvas size, tool mode, selection state, and undo/redo availability.

set.description: Replace the SVG content in the editor. Changes apply immediately. Call save afterward to write to disk.

save.description: Save the current SVG content to disk. Uses the open file path by default. When no file is open, path is required.

path.description: Absolute path to save to. Required when no file is open; optional to save-as to a new path.

export_png.description: Rasterize the current SVG to a PNG file at the canvas resolution.

path.description: Absolute path for the PNG output
